entries.text: Day 6: Day 6: I found a crust that was worse than a poorly folded map. Pino thinks rhythm is like a teaspoon of sugar. Derek stood at the station-fountain like he owned it. I sat at the memorial, nothing rolled my way. I re-read about wheels made of bottle caps. I tried to imagine a perfect sphere, but settled for circles. The pigeons ignored me. I found flatbread under a table at De Turk. Natural rubber comes from latex. I did not say a word to Derek. I did not trust the crust. I did not trust the wheels. I did not trust the silence.
